# MCP client dependency

The SDK references ModelContextProtocol.Core 2.2.0, the official C# MCP client package.
Its repository revision is `6fa3825973949a9c4f0cd8af344e15a8db09dc35`.
Only the dependency's repository license is copied here. The release bundles include the package's compiled dependency and this complete license/transition notice.

Source: https://github.com/modelcontextprotocol/csharp-sdk
Documentation: https://csharp.sdk.modelcontextprotocol.io/v2/concepts/transports/transports.html
